description: This file contains a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' implementing methods defined in the PSR-7 MessageInterface. It manages HTTP message headers, protocol version, and body stream, and provides mutator and accessor methods for these components, facilitating immutable message objects.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version as a string, e.g., '1.1' or '2.0'.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the message with the specified HTTP protocol version, enforcing immutability.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all message headers as an associative array of header names to value arrays.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks for existence of a header by case-insensitive name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns all values for a given header as an array of strings.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns all header values concatenated into a single comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with the specified header set, replacing existing values.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message with the specified header's values appended to existing ones.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new message instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Provides access to the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new message instance with a different body stream.
